# Docs

- Speko Platform: Voice routing, agents, and API fundamentals.
  - [Speko](https://docs.speko.dev/): One API for every voice provider. Speko benchmarks STT, LLM, and TTS in real time and routes each call to the best provider for your language and latency/cost target.
  - Quickstart
    - [Quickstart](https://docs.speko.dev/quickstart): From sign-up to your first transcribe call in under five minutes.
    - [MCP](https://docs.speko.dev/quickstart/mcp): Connect Speko to Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
  - Concepts
    - [How routing works](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/routing): Intent + benchmark scores → ranked candidates → live failover. The model behind every Speko call.
    - [Bring your own keys](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/byok): Use your own provider credentials. Speko routes; providers bill you directly.
    - [Failover](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/failover): How Speko transparently retries against runner-up providers when the primary fails.
    - [Benchmarks and scoring](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/scoring): How provider scores are computed and refreshed.
    - [Sessions vs one-shot](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/sessions): When to mint a session and when to call a one-shot endpoint directly.
    - [Agents](https://docs.speko.dev/concepts/agents): Reusable voice personas — system prompt, voice, and intent defaults that any session can be started against.
  - Build
    - [Real-time browser conversation](https://docs.speko.dev/guides/realtime-conversation): Wire @spekoai/client into a web app — mint a session, join the transport, stream voice both ways.
    - [Build a voice agent](https://docs.speko.dev/guides/voice-agent): Real-time STT → LLM → TTS pipeline using @spekoai/adapter-livekit on a LiveKit Agents worker.
    - [Build a phone agent](https://docs.speko.dev/guides/phone-agents): Inbound and outbound PSTN calls, phone-number routing, lifecycle webhooks, reports, and transfers.
    - [One-shot APIs](https://docs.speko.dev/guides/one-shot): POST /v1/transcribe, /v1/synthesize, /v1/complete — single-turn calls without sessions.
    - [Tool calling](https://docs.speko.dev/guides/tool-calling): Give a Speko voice agent the ability to invoke webhook tools mid-call. Register once in the dashboard, fire from any voice session.
  - SMS
    - [SMS on Speko](https://docs.speko.dev/sms): Send text messages from your Speko phone numbers: prerequisites, carrier registration, timelines, and APIs.
    - [Register for SMS (10DLC)](https://docs.speko.dev/sms/registration): Register your brand and messaging campaign with the US and Canadian carriers so your Speko numbers are cleared to send SMS.
    - [Registration API](https://docs.speko.dev/sms/api): Automate 10DLC brand, campaign, and number registration with the /v1/sms/10dlc endpoints.
    - [Send messages](https://docs.speko.dev/sms/sending): Current SMS sending status and the supported interim pattern for transactional texts.
  - API Reference
    - [Introduction](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/introduction): Public REST API for the Speko voice gateway.
    - [Sessions](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/sessions): Mints browser-safe media transport credentials, persists the pipeline config, and dispatches an agent worker. Use the returned `transportToken` and `transportUrl` with `@spekoai/client` to join from a browser.
    - [Create phone session](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/sessions-phone): POST /v1/sessions/phone — place an outbound PSTN call backed by a Speko voice session.
    - [Transcribe](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/transcribe): Routes the request to the best STT provider for your `(language, region, optimizeFor)` intent, with automatic failover to runner-up providers. Body is binary audio. Routing intent goes in the `x-speko-intent` header (JSON).
    - [Synthesize](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/synthesize): Routes the request to the best TTS provider for your intent, with automatic failover. Returns binary audio. The `Content-Type` header (mirrored in `X-Speko-Audio-Format`) tells you the format.
    - [Voices](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/voices): Read-only catalog of TTS voices grouped by provider. ElevenLabs voices are account-scoped and fetched live from ElevenLabs rather than returned here.
    - [Complete](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/complete): Single-turn LLM call routed to the best provider for your intent, with automatic failover. Returns assistant text + token usage.
    - [List agents](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agents-list): Returns every agent belonging to the authenticated organization. Agents are scoped per-org — IDs from another org will never appear here.
    - [Create agent](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agents-create): Persists a reusable voice persona — `systemPrompt`, optional `voice`, routing `intent`, and optional `llmOptions` — keyed by `name` within the authenticated organization. Pass the returned `id` as `agentId` on `POST /v1/sessions` to seed a session from this agent.
    - [Get agent](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agents-get): Fetch a single agent by id. Scoped to the authenticated organization — agents owned by another org always return 404.
    - [Update agent](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agents-update): Partial update — every field on the body is optional and only supplied keys are written. Updating `name` to one already used by another agent in the org returns 409.
    - [Delete agent](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agents-delete): Removes the agent and its registered tools. The organization's only remaining agent cannot be deleted and returns 409.
    - [List agent calls](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/agent-calls): GET /v1/agents/{id}/calls — list recent calls for an agent.
    - [Phone numbers](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/phone-numbers): Provision managed numbers, import SIP-trunk numbers, update routing, and manage phone-number business verification.
    - [Calls](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/calls): Inspect call detail, events, reports, recordings, and live call transfers.
    - [Callbacks](https://docs.speko.dev/api-reference/callbacks): List, inspect, cancel, and dispatch scheduled callbacks created from call analysis.
- Speko SDK: TypeScript HTTP SDK for the Speko voice gateway.
  - [@spekoai/sdk](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/overview): Official TypeScript SDK — one API, every voice provider.
  - [Speko client](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/speko-client): Construct the SDK client and configure transport options.
  - [transcribe](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/transcribe): POST /v1/transcribe — speech-to-text with automatic provider routing.
  - [synthesize](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/synthesize): POST /v1/synthesize — text-to-speech with automatic provider routing.
  - [voices](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/voices): GET /v1/voices — read-only catalog of TTS voices grouped by provider.
  - [complete](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/complete): POST /v1/complete — LLM completion with automatic provider routing.
  - [realtime](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/realtime): Speech-to-speech WebSocket sessions — OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, xAI Grok Voice, and Inworld.
  - [voice](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/voice): Outbound phone calls through POST /v1/sessions/phone.
  - [phone numbers](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/phone-numbers): Provision managed numbers, import SIP trunk numbers, and manage phone-number business verification.
  - [calls](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/calls): Inspect calls, reports, events, recordings, and transfers.
  - [callbacks](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/callbacks): Scheduled callback resources created from call analysis.
  - [usage](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/usage): GET /v1/usage — billing and usage reporting.
  - [credits](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/credits): Prepaid balance and append-only ledger.
  - [Types](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/types): Shared request / response types exported from @spekoai/sdk.
  - [Errors](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk/errors): Exception classes thrown by @spekoai/sdk.
- Speko Client: Browser SDK for real-time voice conversations.
  - [@spekoai/client](https://docs.speko.dev/client/overview): Browser SDK for real-time voice conversations.
  - [VoiceConversation](https://docs.speko.dev/client/voice-conversation): Primary API — construct, control, and tear down a voice session.
  - [RealtimeVoiceConversation](https://docs.speko.dev/client/realtime-voice-conversation): Browser capture and playback for direct speech-to-speech WebSocket sessions.
  - [Callbacks & events](https://docs.speko.dev/client/callbacks): Every hook VoiceConversation exposes, and when they fire.
  - [Data channel protocol](https://docs.speko.dev/client/data-channel): Wire format for packets exchanged between browser and agent over the media data channel.
  - [Errors](https://docs.speko.dev/client/errors): SpekoClientError and its error codes.
- Adapter LiveKit: LiveKit Agents adapters for Speko STT, LLM, and TTS.
  - [@spekoai/adapter-livekit](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/overview): LiveKit Agents adapter — route STT, LLM, and TTS through Speko.
  - [createSpekoComponents](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/create-speko-components): Build a { stt, llm, tts } bundle ready for voice.AgentSession.
  - [SpekoSTT](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/speko-stt): LiveKit Agents STT adapter backed by POST /v1/transcribe.
  - [SpekoLLM](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/speko-llm): LiveKit Agents LLM adapter backed by POST /v1/complete.
  - [SpekoTTS](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/speko-tts): LiveKit Agents TTS adapter backed by POST /v1/synthesize.
  - [Intent](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/intent): Routing hint type and construction-time validator.
  - [Audio helpers](https://docs.speko.dev/adapter-livekit/audio): WAV encode / decode and MIME parsing utilities.
- spekoai Python: Sync and async Python SDK for Speko.
  - [spekoai (Python)](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/overview): Official Python SDK for the Speko voice gateway — sync + async.
  - [transcribe](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/transcribe): POST /v1/transcribe — speech-to-text with automatic provider routing.
  - [synthesize](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/synthesize): POST /v1/synthesize — text-to-speech with automatic provider routing.
  - [complete](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/complete): POST /v1/complete — LLM completion with automatic provider routing.
  - [connect_realtime](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/realtime): Speech-to-speech WebSocket sessions, async only.
  - [usage](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/usage): GET /v1/usage — billing and usage reporting.
  - [credits](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/credits): Prepaid credit balance and append-only ledger.
  - [Errors](https://docs.speko.dev/sdk-python/errors): Typed exceptions raised by the Python SDK.
